description: Costs 2¢ per call. Finds alternative and second-source parts for an MPN that is out of stock, end of life or too expensive, ranked by match_score with match_notes. Candidates come from provider search and from parts with the same function in our own datasheet index; they must do the same job (an accelerometer is not offered for a 6-axis IMU) and are compared on named electrical specs. Each has a lifecycle, stock and datasheet_status; obsolete and NRND parts rank last. Constraints: 'same_package' (fuzzy: SOT-23 ≡ SOT23, SOIC-8 ≡ SOP-8), 'in_stock', 'jlcpcb'. They are never relaxed silently: a candidate that fails one is left out of alternatives, removed_by_constraints counts what each removed, and when that leaves too few, relaxed_matches lists the best ones with the constraints they failed. When nothing matches at all, the call returns error_type 'not_found' (not charged) with the parts that would match without the constraints, under matches_without_constraints. The part's own family is also searched among datasheets already read (e.g. CH340C for CH340G). A score is similarity, not verified pin or electrical compatibility: check pinout and limits before substituting. Eval boards and modules are excluded. compact=true gives shorter rows (no per-source data or price breaks) and leaves out the reference part's summary unless include_original_summary=true. For a head-to-head of candidates you already have, use compare_parts. Example: find_alternative('TPS54302', constraints=['same_package', 'in_stock']) datasheet_status: 'ready' → read it; 'extracting' / 'queued' / 'pending' / 'resolving' → poll check_extraction_status; 'not_extracted' → prefetch_datasheets; 'no_source' / 'unsupported' → request_datasheet_upload. Full list in the server instructions.

compact.description: Return the shorter answer: one short row per candidate (identity, lifecycle, stock, cheapest price, providers, match notes) and no reference-part summary. Default false: the full answer.

constraints.description: Optional filters. 'in_stock' = known non-zero stock at some provider. 'same_package' = same footprint (fuzzy). 'jlcpcb' = orderable at JLCPCB (also limits the provider search to JLCPCB).

include_original_summary.description: With compact=true, also return the reference part's cached datasheet summary (about 2-3k characters). The full answer always has it.

part_number.description: Specific manufacturer part number (MPN) or LCSC number (e.g. 'TPS54302DDCR', 'C2837938'). Not a value ('100nF'), description or reference designator ('R1').
